title: Home guide: the bag stretch test
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Making materials (9E); conservation of energy
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 19 (Home practical guide and safety card: bag stretch test (portal worksheet; adult cuts strips, work over a cushion))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Compare the strength and stretch of three polymers.
equipment: A small bag of rice and kitchen scales
safety: Work over a cushion in case the rice falls
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: An adult cuts a strip 2 cm wide and 10 cm long from each bag.
Hang the rice bag from a strip and measure the new length.
Add rice in steps, weighing it, until the strip snaps or stretches a lot.
Repeat three times for each bag and calculate the mean.
If you cannot test, use the example data from the lesson.
